canada.title: Sask. musician's terminal brain cancer diagnosis prompts outpouring of support

bds.h: Binance says 90% of losses from $6.3bn hack covered as FBI says North Korea behind attack
bds.lede: Cryptocurrency exchange says withdrawals expected to resume on Sunday as FBI blames North Korean state-sponsored group TraderTraitor
rows: Cryptocurrency exchange says withdrawals expected to resume on Sunday as FBI blames North Korean state-sponsored group TraderTraitor
Crypto firm Binance says it has covered 90 percent of losses from the multibillion-dollar hack.
The theft of billions of dollars from Binance within a matter of minutes, the biggest crypto heist in history, was orchestrated by North Korean hackers, the FBI said Saturday.
Binance has said it will cover about 90% of the loss and plans to restore withdrawals, making progress on a pledge to fully reimburse customers.
A cyberattack on Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, was likely carried out by North Korea, according to a blockchain intelligence firm.
